SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q4. Identify the crop with the help of the following information: 
• It is a kharif crop. 
• It requires temperature between 21∘𝐶 to 27∘𝐶. 
• It grows well in old alluvial soil. 
Option:  
(A) Rice  
(B) Sugarcane  
(C) Maize  
(D) Wheat

Answer / Solution:
Identify the crop with the help of the following information: 
(C) Maize 
Reasoning: Maize is a kharif crop, grows well in old alluvial soil, and requires 
a temperature between 21∘𝐶 to 27∘𝐶.
